newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end lower, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end lower, seen falling.

text.p: Pakistani stocks fell on Wednesday as major players offloaded blue chips, but dealers said short covering by individuals helped resist a sharp slide.
They said the index was likely to slip lower on Thursday amid bearish sentiment prompted by uncertain political and gloomy economic outlook.
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index fell 12.15 points, or 0.89 percent, to end at 1,352.93 after slipping to 1,348.18 in early trade.
Losers led gainers 137 to 66. Turnover rose to 19.67 million shares from 16.70 million on Tuesday.
Muslim Commercial Bank fell 0.75 to 33.50 rupees, Adamjee Insurance 1.50 to 83.50, Hub Power Co 0.05 to 29.20, Karachi Electric Supply 1.50 to 18 and Pakistan State Oil 7.0 to 325.
PTCL lost slipped 0.90 to 30.75, Engro Chemical 1.50 to 138.50 and ICI Pakistan 0.40 to 16.75.
